definitions.explanation: A newspaper edition published and delivered in the afternoon or evening, as opposed to the morning edition.

examples.japanese: {夕刊|ゆうかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
{夕刊|ゆうかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{届|とど}いていない→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: The evening paper hasn't arrived yet.

examples.japanese: うち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{朝刊|ちょうかん}→朝刊：16382_choukan⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{夕刊|ゆうかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{取|と}っていない→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: We only get the morning paper and don't subscribe to the evening edition.

notes:
USAGE:
Many Japanese newspapers offer both ⟦{朝刊|ちょうかん}→朝刊：16382_choukan⟧ (morning edition) and {夕刊|ゆうかん} (evening edition) as a set subscription. The evening edition is typically thinner and covers afternoon developments.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夕刊|ゆうかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ (to read the evening paper)
- {夕刊|ゆうかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to subscribe to the evening edition)
- {朝|あさ}{夕刊|ゆうかん}⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧ (morning and evening edition set)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{朝刊|ちょうかん}→朝刊：16382_choukan⟧: morning newspaper — the main daily edition, typically larger than the evening edition
